purpose: staged, provenance-first general-purpose learning; independent base-model and integrated-system evaluation

stages.name: foundation_pretraining
stages.promotion: held-out loss, source/time holdouts, privacy and contamination review

datasets.notes: filtered train only; conservative PII/phone checks; token share measured with fitted tokenizer

stages.name: domain_adaptive_pretraining
stages.method: continued next-token training with a bounded general-data replay mixture

datasets.license_policy: repository/file exact SPDX allowlist; default permissive allowlist only
datasets.filter: Python syntax, source hash, repository grouped split, obvious secret/contact patterns

datasets.split: filtered train only; never upstream test or _removed
datasets.use: 85/15 document-weight mixture with FineWeb-Edu before tokenizer training; actual token share recorded
datasets.caveats: 20.2 TB full corpus; Bengali subset about 22.25 GB on disk; residual PII likely and phone numbers not upstream-filtered

stages.promotion: domain uplift without unacceptable general or multilingual forgetting

stages.name: instruction_sft

datasets.languages: 65 languages / 71 with dialects and scripts; Bengali ben listed mid-resource

stages.promotion: protected instruction-following and multilingual test suite

stages.name: verified_outcome_training
stages.method: train only on examples with independent exact validators
stages.promotion: sandbox isolation, hidden tests, no reward hacking

stages.name: human_preference_learning
stages.method: DPO-like preference optimization from human chosen/rejected pairs
stages.promotion: human preference agreement and regression checks

stages.name: environment_outcome_optimization
stages.method: RL/GRPO-style outcome optimisation in bounded environments
stages.promotion: verified rewards, matched budgets, rollback and reward-hacking analysis

stages.name: multimodal
stages.promotion: modality-specific source rights and protected evaluations

stages.name: audio_speech_branch
stages.method: ASR/speech encoder supervised learning; separate from text-only ArtemisLM

datasets.notes: Current Bengali listing about 24.85 GB MP3

stages.promotion: word/character error rates, speaker-held-out generalisation, noise robustness, attribution/privacy review

compute.first_gpu_target: Kaggle Notebook GPU allocation when available
compute.fallback: Google Colab free GPU allocation when available
compute.github_actions: CPU unit tests and integrity checks only; recurring model training runs on Kaggle GPU through continuous-kaggle-training.yml and requires Kaggle credentials plus a private persistent state dataset.
compute.potential_intro_gpu_provider: Lightning AI Studios (conditional free credits; eligibility and country availability vary; never assume zero-cost GPU time)

continuous_cycle.tokenizer: tokenizer.model; reused byte-identically across continued-pretraining cycles

per_cycle.sample_seeds: deterministic and derived from the foundation checkpoint run count
per_cycle.foundation_phase: continued_pretraining from the last foundation checkpoint
per_cycle.task_phase: response-only task_sft from the cycle's Aya checkpoint

invariants: The next cycle resumes only the foundation checkpoint, never an Aya or task-SFT candidate.
The SentencePiece tokenizer and vocabulary are reused unchanged after the first foundation cycle.
Each streamed source records its immutable revision and per-cycle sampling seed.
Only the official GSM8K training file is used; validation is derived deterministically from it and the official test file is never ingested.
MBPP training IDs are 601-974 and validation IDs 511-600; prompt IDs 1-10 and protected test IDs 11-510 are excluded.
No model-generated examples enter training without human review and independent verification.
The Kaggle state dataset remains private and stores checkpoints, tokenizer, manifests, and hashes, never API credentials.
continuous_cycle.promotion: A completed cycle produces a candidate only; promotion requires protected exact-answer, isolated code-execution, multilingual and regression evaluations.
